You User response: How do I use it properly the very first time? 03:13 pm Agent response: Nice choice — the Classics are easy to use and low-fuss for a first-timer. Here’s a short, practical step-by-step to get you started 😎1) Unbox & inspect - Take them out of the pouch and check the lenses for any shipping smudges or defects. If anything looks wrong, keep the packaging and contact us.2) Clean before first wear - Use the included microfiber pouch (it doubles as a cleaning cloth) or a lens-safe cleaner. Gently wipe in straight strokes — don’t use household paper or clothing which can scratch.3) Put them on properly - Hold the frames by the temples (arms) and place them on your nose. Make sure the bridge sits comfortably and the temples rest lightly behind your ears. The Classics are designed for small–medium faces.4) Check the fit & comfort - Move your head around and smile. They should stay put without pinching. If they feel tight, try a different color/variant or give them a gentle, careful bend at the temple (only if you feel comfortable doing this — otherwise ask us for tips).5) Test the polarization (if you picked polarized) - Look at a reflective surface (car hood, water) — polarized lenses should noticeably reduce glare and improve clarity. You can also rotate your phone screen while looking through the lens: brightness may change if polarization is present.6) First-time wear tips - Wear them outdoors for at least 10–15 minutes to confirm comfort and visibility in bright light. Avoid leaving them on the dash of a hot car.7) Care & storage basics - Store in the pouch or a case when not in use. Clean only with microfiber + lens cleaner. Avoid harsh chemicals and rough surfaces. Don’t sit on them or toss them loose in a bag.8) If something’s wrong - Keep your order info handy.
